main_text.p: שַׁעֲיָ Chal. Laevis, mollis,glaber,blandus. Plur. שְׁעִיעִין. Foem.שַׁעִיעָא. Plur. שַׁעִיעָן, Psalm.12.3.55.22.
שְׁעִיעוּת Ch. Laevitas, mollities, glabrities, blandities: Item Foramen, caverna, בְּשַׁעִיעוּת כֵּיף גֵּלִי In foramine petrae, Hebr. בִּנְקִיק. Reg.in limpidisfima petra, Jerem.14.3.
שַׁעֲשִׁיעָא Chal. Idem, עַל שַׁעֲשִׁיעַת צוּרִיהּ Propter glabritiem colli sui,Gen.33.4.in Targ.Jon.
שַׁעַף שְׁעִיף Ch. Species aromatis certi, vel Balsami, Genef.37.25.& 43.11.respondet Hebrgo נִבְאַת: Ezech.27.17.& Jerem.51.8.Hebr.צְרִי.

שַׁעַר שַׁעֲרָא Chald. Mensura: Æstimatio, Taxatio: Faenus. Plural. בִּשְׁעָרִין In aestimationes, Hebr. בִּנְשַׁךְ In usuram, Levit. 25.36.37.in Jonath.Exod.22.24. in eodem. Cum Aff. בִּרְשַׁעֲרוֹהִי In mensuris suis, Genef. 26.12.
שִׁיעוֹר Ch. Idem.Ruth.7.17.Gen.21.16.Exo.30.13. Num. 25.8.in Jon. Plur. שִׁיעוּרִי, שִׁיעוּרִין.
שַׁעַר שַׁעֲרָא Ch. Pilus, capillus. Plur.שַׁעֲרָן. Scribitur etiam cum ם.
שְׁעָרָן Ch. Pilosus, hirsutus. Plur. שְׁעָרָנִין Pilosae manus, Genef. 27.23.
שַׁעֲרְתָּא, שַׁעֲרָא, שְׁעוּרָא Ch. Vide in מַעַר.
שִׁפּוּרָא Ch. Veru.Plur.emphat.שִׁפּוּרָיָא Numer. 31.23.in Jon.Derivatum est ex Graeco σπάθη, unde & Lat. Spatha, Ital.Spedo,Belg.Spitt,Germ.Spiß.
שְׁפַר Chald. Tritum, attritum, contritum esse: terere,atterere,conterere: Item Quietum, tranquillum esse.Pahel שַׁפֵּי Idem.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vowel points and small Hebrew forms are uncertain and may contain errors. The final catchword-like Hebrew word "שפי" at the foot is taken as a signature.
